item: the server always runs on the stdlib asyncio loop, never uvloop
summary: uvicorn's loop=auto picked uvloop, whose resolves and connects bypass the airplane socket guard; _serve now pins loop=asyncio and lifespan logs an error if a server started another way runs on uvloop. Release line: the app's server now always runs on Python's own event loop, so airplane mode's network guard also covers network calls made from it.
